// diagnostic

E3403

`{what}` is non-deterministic and cannot appear in a pure evaluation.

What

`{what}` is non-deterministic and cannot appear in a pure evaluation.

Why

Pure evaluation must produce the same result on every machine (D-PURE2).

Fix

remove this call, or remove the enclosing function's explicit empty effect bound.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3403: tests/ui/clock_system_pure.stderr.

Error [E3403]: `Clock.system` is non-deterministic and cannot appear in a pure evaluation.
  --> tests/ui/clock_system_pure.jet:3:20
    |
  3 |     clock := Clock.system()
    |                    ^^^^^^
 Why: pure evaluation must produce the same result on every machine (D-PURE2).
 Fix: remove this call, or remove the enclosing function's explicit empty effect bound.
